currentThesis: CivicState will be worth building only if ordinary U.S. residents will pay for a citation-backed, jurisdiction-aware civic letter workflow that converts a specific complaint into verified official outreach faster than they can research, draft, and route it themselves.
identityConstraints: CivicState will not provide legal advice or legal filings.
CivicState will not become a petitions, crowdfunding, or social-network product before the paid letter workflow is proven.
CivicState will not claim production-grade deliverability, official coverage, or legal safety without operator-reviewed evidence.
CivicState will not build an independent long-term auth, billing, or identity chassis if WrkPlug becomes the portfolio standard.
